tools.name: list_project_endpoints
tools.description: List project endpoints with their IDs, draft status, latest published version, and line usage.

tools.name: get_project_endpoint
tools.description: Read a project endpoint with its numbered versions and draft. Credentials are redacted.

tools.name: create_project_endpoint
tools.description: Create a project endpoint draft. Pass publish: true to publish version 1 immediately.

tools.name: save_project_endpoint_draft
tools.description: Replace the unpublished endpoint draft with a complete endpoint document.

tools.name: discard_project_endpoint_draft
tools.description: Discard the unpublished endpoint draft.

tools.name: publish_project_endpoint_draft
tools.description: Publish the endpoint draft. Line versions following latest pick it up after verification.

tools.name: delete_project_endpoint
tools.description: Delete an unused endpoint or retire it when a line draft or published line version still references it.

tools.name: attach_line_endpoint
tools.description: Attach a published endpoint to a line draft. Defaults to following latest.

tools.name: detach_line_endpoint
tools.description: Remove an endpoint from a line draft. Publish the draft to apply the removal.

tools.name: switch_line_version_endpoint
tools.description: Switch a published line attachment to follow latest or lock to a published endpoint version. Keeps the same line version number.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get the EchoRelay project this token is scoped to: id, slug, name, caller-facing API base URL, whether the token has edit access, and the request-log hot-tier retention window.

tools.name: preview_line_draft

tools.name: publish_line_draft
tools.description: Publish one line draft now and clear only its schedule.

tools.name: cancel_line_publish
tools.description: Cancel one line schedule before its two-minute lock.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "duplicate_line" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Copy a line and all its endpoints/targets/rules into a new line key — build v2 from v1. The copy is saved inactive and remains off the data plane; edit it, then activate_line when ready. Requires edit access." → after: "Copy a line and all its endpoints/targets/rules into a new line key — build v2 from v1. The copy is saved inactive and remains off the data plane until a version is switched on with switch_line_version. Requires edit access."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "delete_credential" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Delete a saved credential. Blocked (not a permission or not-found error — a validation error) while any target still references it; repoint or remove those targets first." → after: "Delete a saved credential. Blocked (not a permission or not-found error — a validation error) while any target version, binding, or draft still references it; repoint or remove those first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
